title: TenantAnalystSettings
description: Tenant-level analyst ability ceilings and web host policy (ADR 0047). A tenant may only narrow what deployment config and the application package allow. Written via PUT /v1/ops/tenants/{tenant_id}/analyst (ops.analyst.write); read via GET (ops.analyst.read) or the effective view on GET /v1/me/analyst.

enabled.description: When false, forces the analyst path off for this tenant. Absent inherits deployment.

abilities.description: Per-ability ceilings. true allows what upper levels allow; false (or absent key when replacing) forces that ability off. Most restrictive wins.

web.description: Tenant web host policy. Intersected with deployment allow/deny and package preferred_web_hosts. Deny wins.

updated_at.description: Set by the core on write.
